notes.title: NVIDIA & Epic Developments at GDC and Beyond!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

We owe you an update, and it’s been for a good reason. We’ve been tirelessly working behind the scenes, attending conventions, and continuously updating our game.

We have had plenty of great news. NVIDIA got in touch after being impressed with our Teaser Trailer, and we have now partnered with them, which is super exciting. Additionally, EPIC seems very impressed with our game, and we hope to see more of them as we continue developing the game.

GDC (Game Developers Conference)

Earlier this year, we had the pleasure of attending GDC for the second time. The event was fantastic! We met numerous publishers and interested parties, gaining significant traction. Our vertical slice showcase received a great reception, with almost everyone impressed by our visuals and gameplay.

Despite many productive meetings, we are still on the lookout for the perfect partner to fund our game. Given the industry’s volatility, finding the right type of funding is crucial for our studio’s longevity. Proxima was created to continue making games beyond Warship Jolly Roger. Therefore, we need financial partners who believe in our team and our vision, not just the game.

Develop: Brighton

Following GDC, we continued our work and attended Develop: Brighton. Although a smaller event, we were impressed by the number of attendees already familiar with our title and eager to learn more. It appears that publishers are once again interested in investing in young and talented studios like ours, which is a promising trend. We hope this momentum continues and things keep getting better from here.

Also in case you are not aware, we now have a podcast, if you like to nerd out about games feel free to have a list...releasing weekly on your favourite platform.

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y7v5CEyBFXE&list=PLg3a-Bxvr6bKDe5v2I2meK9zeXqghGfiW
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/28l98Vc4RHDgmsydR6asi1
Apple Podcasts: https://feeds.acast.com/public/shows/655cbab40020990012e2defc

Thank you for your continued support. We’ll keep you posted with more exciting updates soon!

Best regards,
The Proxima Studios Team

notes.title: Our Game Trailer Hits 250K Views!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794802/9e4fc55dfb645e88fd8e6b7b0892b2ad2d272cb3.jpg[/img]
We've been diligently working on a future playable demo, and we're excited to share more about that soon. It's heartening to celebrate a significant milestone: our trailer has garnered over 250,000 views in just a little over a month since its release.

Notably, our trailer caught the attention of major industry platforms like IGN and Gametrailers, which have amplified its reach by featuring it on their channels.

It's gratifying to witness such robust interest in our game. Game development can be a solitary endeavor, and while we are passionate about our project, the true measure of interest becomes apparent only when it's shared with the world.

We look forward to revealing more details in the coming months, including extensive gameplay previews, to give everyone a deeper insight into the game we are crafting. We're eager to share more with you soon.

Thank you for all your support. Stay tuned for our next update!

notes.title: IGN Entertainment Features Our Trailer: A Big Moment for Our Team!
notes.content:
Hello, wonderful gaming community!

We're thrilled to announce that our game trailer has been featured on IGN Entertainment's website! This is a huge milestone for us, and we're over the moon about seeing our hard work showcased alongside some of the biggest titles in the gaming world right now.

Check Out the Feature!
Haven't seen the trailer yet or want to relive the excitement? You can watch it right now on IGN's website! Here's the link to dive straight into the action: [url=https://www.ign.com/videos/warship-jolly-roger-official-teaser-trailer]IGN Feature - Our Game Trailer[/url]

A Heartfelt Thanks
We want to extend a massive thank you to IGN for recognizing our game and to all of you for your unwavering support. It's your enthusiasm and feedback that fuel our passion and drive our development forward.

Stay Tuned for More
This is just the beginning! We've got lots more in store for you. So, keep your eyes peeled for updates, sneak peeks, and more exciting news!
